newsitem.title: USA: Brimm Energy enters merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Brimm Energy enters merger talks.

text.p: Vancouver-based Brimm Energy Corp said Tuesday it began preliminary merger talks with a privately-held oil and gas exploration company.
The company said in a statement it also appointed a financial advisor to seek out and evaluate opportunities to increase long-term shareholder value.
"Discussions are in a very early stage and there can be no assurance an agreement will be reached," President Daniel Brimm said in a statement.
"The board of directors is still conducting due diligence and will be seeking the advice of its financial and legal advisors before entering into a letter of intent," he said.
Brimm also said it was encouraging that corn prices had fallen sharply in the last week, prompting major ethanol producers to bring production facilities back on line.
Brimm's ethanol plant was set to reopen in the fourth quarter this year, the company said.
Ethanol prices were also high, due to higher demand created by the Clean Air Act, Brimm said.
Brimm Energy made and distributed fuel grade ethanol for use as a gasoline additive in the Rocky Mountains and northwestern United States.
